tool_schemas.name: maps_regeocode
tool_schemas.description: 对一个或多个经纬度坐标执行逆地理编码，返回对应的结构化地址信息；当 extensions=all 时还会返回周边 POI 等扩展字段，radius/poitype/roadlevel/homeorcorp 用于约束扩展结果范围与类型。batch=true 时可用“|”分隔批量 location，结果按输入顺序返回且不分页。参数格式不符合（如 location 非“lng,lat”、batch=true 但坐标列表为空、枚举值非法）将返回 VALIDATION_ERROR；鉴权缺失/无权或会话不可用返回 UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN；超过配额/触发限流返回 QUOTA_EXCEEDED/RATE_LIMITED；上游无结果通常返回空结果集（不抛 NOT_FOUND），上游不可用或超时返回 UPSTREAM_ERROR。

location.description: 要逆地理编码的经纬度坐标，格式为"经度,纬度"（例如："116.434307,39.90909"）。

radius.description: 搜索半径（米），用于限定返回的周边POI范围。

extensions.description: 返回结果控制：base仅返回基础地址信息；all返回包含POI等扩展信息。

poitype.description: POI类型过滤（高德POI类型编码），多个用“|”分隔。

roadlevel.description: 道路级别过滤：0不过滤；1过滤掉高速等高等级道路信息（以高德实际定义为准）。

homeorcorp.description: 是否优先返回住宅/公司：0不启用；1启用（以高德实际策略为准）。

batch.description: 是否批量逆地理编码；为true时location可传多个坐标点（以“|”分隔）。

tool_schemas.name: maps_geo
tool_schemas.description: 将一个或多个详细地址/地标名称进行地理编码，返回匹配到的经纬度坐标及相关的标准化地址信息；可选 city 用于提高解析准确率。batch=true 时 address 允许用“|”分隔批量请求，结果按输入顺序返回且不分页。address 为空或批量格式不合法、output 枚举值非法等将返回 VALIDATION_ERROR；鉴权/会话问题返回 UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN；超过调用配额或触发限流返回 QUOTA_EXCEEDED/RATE_LIMITED；无法解析到坐标时返回空匹配列表而非 NOT_FOUND，上游错误返回 UPSTREAM_ERROR。

address.description: 结构化/非结构化详细地址或地标名称（例如："北京市朝阳区阜通东大街6号"）。

city.description: 可选城市信息，用于提高地理编码准确率（城市名、citycode或adcode均可）。

batch.description: 是否批量地理编码；为true时address可传多个地址（以“|”分隔）。

tool_schemas.name: maps_ip_location
tool_schemas.description: 根据输入的 IPv4 地址进行 IP 定位，返回该 IP 对应的省市/区县等归属地信息；本工具按参数直接查询并返回单次结果，不涉及分页。ip 不是合法 IPv4 或 output 枚举值非法将返回 VALIDATION_ERROR；鉴权缺失/无权或会话不可用返回 UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN；超过配额或触发限流返回 QUOTA_EXCEEDED/RATE_LIMITED；上游无法定位该 IP 时返回空/缺省定位信息而非 NOT_FOUND，上游不可用返回 UPSTREAM_ERROR。

ip.description: 要定位的IPv4地址；为空时按请求来源IP定位（如后端支持）。

tool_schemas.name: maps_weather
tool_schemas.description: 根据城市名称或标准 adcode 查询指定城市天气，extensions=base 返回实况天气，extensions=all 返回预报天气（以高德返回为准）。该接口返回单个城市的天气结果，不分页。city 为空或 extensions/output 枚举值非法将返回 VALIDATION_ERROR；鉴权/会话异常返回 UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN；超过配额或触发限流返回 QUOTA_EXCEEDED/RATE_LIMITED；城市不可识别时返回空结果而非 NOT_FOUND，上游异常返回 UPSTREAM_ERROR。

city.description: 城市名称或标准adcode（例如："北京"或"110000"）。

extensions.description: 返回结果类型：base为实况天气；all为预报天气。

tool_schemas.name: maps_bicycling_by_address
tool_schemas.description: 基于起点/终点地址进行骑行路径规划：服务先对地址进行地理编码（可用 origin_city/destination_city 提升准确率），再返回包含距离、预计时长与分段导航信息的路线结果。该工具返回一次规划结果（可能包含多条候选线路，具体以高德返回为准），不分页。地址为空或无法规范化将返回 VALIDATION_ERROR；鉴权缺失/无权或会话不可用返回 UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN；超过配额/触发限流返回 QUOTA_EXCEEDED/RATE_LIMITED；地址无法解析为坐标或无可用骑行方案时返回 NO_ROUTE，上游异常返回 UPSTREAM_ERROR。

origin_address.description: 起点地址（例如："北京市朝阳区阜通东大街6号"）。

destination_address.description: 终点地址（例如："北京市海淀区上地十街10号"）。

origin_city.description: 可选起点城市，用于提高起点地址地理编码准确率。

destination_city.description: 可选终点城市，用于提高终点地址地理编码准确率。

tool_schemas.implementation:
def maps_bicycling_by_address(origin_address, destination_address, origin_city=None, destination_city=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, hashlib, random, re
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0086000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0086000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0)
    now_iso = now.isoformat() + "Z"

    tool_name = "maps_bicycling_by_address"

    def _new_id(prefix):
        return f"{prefix}_{datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}_{random.randint(100000, 999999)}"

    def _parse_and_normalize_address(s):
        if not isinstance(s, str):
            return None
        x = s.strip()
        x = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", x)
        if not x:
            return None
        return x

    def _normalize_city(s):
        if s is None:
            return None
        if not isinstance(s, str):
            return "__INVALID__"
        x = s.strip()
        x = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", x)
        return x if x else None

    def _hash_cache_key(tool, normalized_params):
        b = json.dumps({"tool": tool, "p": normalized_params}, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
        return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()

    def _pick_context(tenants, api_keys):
        # Ambient auth: pick any working active tenant, and an active api_key under it if available.
        for t in tenants:
            if t.get("status") == "active":
                for k in api_keys:
                    if k.get("status") == "active" and k.get("tenant_id") == t.get("id"):
                        return t, k
                # allow tenant-level context without api key if none exists
                return t, None
        return None, None

    def _window_start(dt, gran):
        if gran == "minute":
            return dt.replace(second=0, microsecond=0)
        if gran == "hour":
            return dt.replace(minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
        if gran == "day":
            return dt.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
        if gran == "month":
            return dt.replace(day=1, hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
        return dt

    def _get_rollup(rollups, tenant_id, api_key_id, tool_name_val, gran, wstart):
        ws = wstart.isoformat() + "Z"
        for r in rollups:
            if (r.get("tenant_id") == tenant_id and r.get("api_key_id") == api_key_id and r.get("tool_name") == tool_name_val
                and r.get("window_granularity") == gran and r.get("window_start") == ws):
                return r
        return None

    def _ensure_rollup(rollups, tenant_id, api_key_id, tool_name_val, gran, wstart):
        r = _get_rollup(rollups, tenant_id, api_key_id, tool_name_val, gran, wstart)
        if r is not None:
            return r
        rid = _new_id("rollup")
        ws = wstart.isoformat() + "Z"
        r = {
            "id": rid,
            "tenant_id": tenant_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key_id,
            "tool_name": tool_name_val,
            "window_start": ws,
            "window_granularity": gran,
            "requests_count": 0,
            "success_count": 0,
            "error_count": 0,
            "rate_limited_count": 0,
            "billed_units": 0,
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso,
        }
        rollups.append(r)
        return r

    def _select_provider_key(provider_keys, tenant_id):
        candidates = [p for p in provider_keys if p.get("tenant_id") == tenant_id and p.get("status") == "active" and isinstance(p.get("weight"), int) and p.get("weight") >= 0]
        if not candidates:
            return None
        # Weighted random selection.
        total = sum(max(0, c.get("weight", 0)) for c in candidates)
        if total <= 0:
            candidates = sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: x.get("id") or "")
            return candidates[0]
        r = random.uniform(0, total)
        upto = 0.0
        for c in candidates:
            w = max(0, c.get("weight", 0))
            upto += w
            if upto >= r:
                return c
        return candidates[-1]

    def _log_tool_call(tool_calls, tenant_id, api_key_id, provider_key_id, status, request_params, normalized_params, cache_key, cache_ttl_seconds, http_status, provider_endpoint, response_body, error_code, error_message, billed_units):
        tc_id = _new_id("call")
        duration_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        row = {
            "id": tc_id,
            "tenant_id": tenant_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key_id,
            "provider_key_id": provider_key_id,
            "mcp_session_id": None,
            "tool_name": tool_name,
            "status": status,
            "request_params": request_params,
            "normalized_params": normalized_params,
            "cache_key": cache_key,
            "cache_ttl_seconds": cache_ttl_seconds,
            "http_status": http_status,
            "provider_endpoint": provider_endpoint,
            "provider_request_id": None,
            "response_body": response_body,
            "error_code": error_code,
            "error_message": error_message,
            "duration_ms": duration_ms if duration_ms >= 0 else 0,
            "billed_units": billed_units,
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso,
        }
        tool_calls.append(row)
        return row

    tenants = _load("tenants.json")
    api_keys = _load("api_keys.json")
    provider_keys = _load("amap_provider_keys.json")
    tool_calls = _load("tool_calls.json")
    rollups = _load("usage_rollups.json")

    tenant, api_key = _pick_context(tenants, api_keys)
    if tenant is None:
        # record attempt without tenant is impossible per schema; return unauthorized without logging
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No active tenant context available to serve this request.")

    tenant_id = tenant.get("id")
    api_key_id = api_key.get("id") if api_key else None

    # Input validation
    oaddr = _parse_and_normalize_address(origin_address)
    daddr = _parse_and_normalize_address(destination_address)
    ocity = _normalize_city(origin_city)
    dcity = _normalize_city(destination_city)
    if oaddr is None or daddr is None:
        # log failed
        _log_tool_call(
            tool_calls, tenant_id, api_key_id, None, "failed",
            {"origin_address": origin_address, "destination_address": destination_address, "origin_city": origin_city, "destination_city": destination_city},
            None, None, None, 400, None, None,
            "INVALID_PARAMS", "origin_address and destination_address must be non-empty strings.", 0
        )
        _save("tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid address parameters.", details={"origin_address": "required" if oaddr is None else None, "destination_address": "required" if daddr is None else None})

    if ocity == "__INVALID__" or dcity == "__INVALID__":
        _log_tool_call(
            tool_calls, tenant_id, api_key_id, None, "failed",
            {"origin_address": origin_address, "destination_address": destination_address, "origin_city": origin_city, "destination_city": destination_city},
            None, None, None, 400, None, None,
            "INVALID_PARAMS", "origin_city/destination_city must be strings when provided.", 0
        )
        _save("tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid city parameters.")

    # Tenant status gate
    if tenant.get("status") in ("suspended", "deleted"):
        _log_tool_call(
            tool_calls, tenant_id, api_key_id, None, "rate_limited",
            {"origin_address": origin_address, "destination_address": destination_address, "origin_city": origin_city, "destination_city": destination_city},
            None, None, None, 429, None, None,
            "TENANT_SUSPENDED", "Tenant is not allowed to create new tool calls.", 0
        )
        # increment tenant rollups
        day = _window_start(now, "day")
        month = _window_start(now, "month")
        r_day = _ensure_rollup(rollups, tenant_id, None, None, "day", day)
        r_month = _ensure_rollup(rollups, tenant_id, None, None, "month", month)
        for r in (r_day, r_month):
            r["requests_count"] += 1
            r["rate_limited_count"] += 1
            r["updated_at"] = now_iso
        _save("usage_rollups.json", rollups)
        _save("tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("RATE_LIMIT", "Tenant is suspended/deleted.")

    # API key validity (if exists)
    if api_key is not None:
        if api_key.get("status") != "active" or api_key.get("tenant_id") != tenant_id:
            _log_tool_call(
                tool_calls, tenant_id, api_key_id, None, "failed",
                {"origin_address": origin_address, "destination_address": destination_address, "origin_city": origin_city, "destination_city": destination_city},
                None, None, None, 401, None, None,
                "UNAUTHORIZED", "API key is invalid for this tenant.", 0
            )
            _save("tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
            return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Invalid API key context.")

    # Rate limit / quota checks (count this request)
    minute = _window_start(now, "minute")
    day = _window_start(now, "day")
    month = _window_start(now, "month")

    # Tenant quota rollups (tenant-level)
    r_t_day = _ensure_rollup(rollups, tenant_id, None, None, "day", day)
    r_t_month = _ensure_rollup(rollups, tenant_id, None, None, "month", month)

    # API key minute rollup (if api key present)
    r_k_min = None
    if api_key_id is not None:
        r_k_min = _ensure_rollup(rollups, tenant_id, api_key_id, None, "minute", minute)

    # Determine if limited
    tenant_daily_quota = tenant.get("daily_request_quota")
    tenant_monthly_quota = tenant.get("monthly_request_quota")
    if not isinstance(tenant_daily_quota, int) or tenant_daily_quota < 0 or not isinstance(tenant_monthly_quota, int) or tenant_monthly_quota < 0:
        _log_tool_call(tool_calls, tenant_id, api_key_id, None, "failed",
                       {"origin_address": origin_address, "destination_address": destination_address, "origin_city": origin_city, "destination_city": destination_city},
                       None, None, None, 500, None, None,
                       "CONFIG_ERROR", "Tenant quota configuration invalid.", 0)
        _save("tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("CONFLICT", "Tenant quota configuration invalid.")

    limited = False
    limit_reason = None
    if r_t_day["requests_count"] >= tenant_daily_quota:
        limited, limit_reason = True, "DAILY_QUOTA"
    elif r_t_month["requests_count"] >= tenant_monthly_quota:
        limited, limit_reason = True, "MONTHLY_QUOTA"
    elif api_key is not None:
        rpm = api_key.get("requests_per_minute_limit")
        if not isinstance(rpm, int) or rpm < 0:
            limited, limit_reason = True, "KEY_LIMIT_CONFIG"
        else:
            if r_k_min["requests_count"] >= rpm:
                limited, limit_reason = True, "RPM_LIMIT"

    normalized = {
        "origin_address": oaddr,
        "destination_address": daddr,
        "origin_city": ocity,
        "destination_city": dcity,
    }
    cache_key = _hash_cache_key(tool_name, normalized)

    # Always increment rollups requests_count on receipt
    r_t_day["requests_count"] += 1
    r_t_month["requests_count"] += 1
    r_t_day["updated_at"] = now_iso
    r_t_month["updated_at"] = now_iso
    if r_k_min is not None:
        r_k_min["requests_count"] += 1
        r_k_min["updated_at"] = now_iso

    if limited:
        # record tool call as rate_limited
        _log_tool_call(
            tool_calls, tenant_id, api_key_id, None, "rate_limited",
            {"origin_address": origin_address, "destination_address": destination_address, "origin_city": origin_city, "destination_city": destination_city},
            normalized, cache_key, 0, 429, None, None,
            "RATE_LIMITED", f"Request was rate limited: {limit_reason}.", 0
        )
        r_t_day["rate_limited_count"] += 1
        r_t_month["rate_limited_count"] += 1
        if r_k_min is not None:
            r_k_min["rate_limited_count"] += 1
        _save("usage_rollups.json", rollups)
        _save("tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("RATE_LIMIT", "Rate limit or quota exceeded.", reason=limit_reason)

    # cache check
    cached = None
    for tc in reversed(tool_calls):
        if tc.get("cache_key") == cache_key and tc.get("tool_name") == tool_name and tc.get("tenant_id") == tenant_id and tc.get("status") == "succeeded":
            ttl = tc.get("cache_ttl_seconds")
            if isinstance(ttl, int) and ttl > 0:
                try:
                    created = tc.get("created_at")
                    created_dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(created.replace("Z", ""))
                    age = (now - created_dt).total_seconds()
                    if age <= ttl:
                        cached = tc
                        break
                except Exception:
                    pass

    cache_ttl_seconds = 300
    if cached is not None:
        response_body = cached.get("response_body")
        _log_tool_call(
            tool_calls, tenant_id, api_key_id, None, "succeeded",
            {"origin_address": origin_address, "destination_address": destination_address, "origin_city": origin_city, "destination_city": destination_city},
            normalized, cache_key, cache_ttl_seconds, 200, None, response_body,
            None, None, 1
        )
        r_t_day["success_count"] += 1
        r_t_month["success_count"] += 1
        r_t_day["billed_units"] += 1
        r_t_month["billed_units"] += 1
        if r_k_min is not None:
            r_k_min["success_count"] += 1
            r_k_min["billed_units"] += 1
        if api_key is not None:
            api_key["last_used_at"] = now_iso
            api_key["updated_at"] = now_iso
            _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)
        _save("usage_rollups.json", rollups)
        _save("tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return {"data": response_body, "meta": {"cached": True, "cache_key": cache_key}}

    # select provider key
    pk = _select_provider_key(provider_keys, tenant_id)
    if pk is None:
        _log_tool_call(
            tool_calls, tenant_id, api_key_id, None, "failed",
            {"origin_address": origin_address, "destination_address": destination_address, "origin_city": origin_city, "destination_city": destination_city},
            normalized, cache_key, cache_ttl_seconds, 503, "amap/bicycling", None,
            "UPSTREAM_ERROR", "No active provider key available for tenant.", 0
        )
        r_t_day["error_count"] += 1
        r_t_month["error_count"] += 1
        if r_k_min is not None:
            r_k_min["error_count"] += 1
        _save("usage_rollups.json", rollups)
        _save("tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No provider key available to dispatch request.")

    # Simulate route result (offline). If addresses look too short -> NO_ROUTE.
    if len(oaddr) < 4 or len(daddr) < 4:
        _log_tool_call(
            tool_calls, tenant_id, api_key_id, pk.get("id"), "failed",
            {"origin_address": origin_address, "destination_address": destination_address, "origin_city": origin_city, "destination_city": destination_city},
            normalized, cache_key, cache_ttl_seconds, 404, "amap/bicycling", None,
            "NO_ROUTE", "No route found for given addresses.", 1
        )
        r_t_day["error_count"] += 1
        r_t_month["error_count"] += 1
        r_t_day["billed_units"] += 1
        r_t_month["billed_units"] += 1
        if r_k_min is not None:
            r_k_min["error_count"] += 1
            r_k_min["billed_units"] += 1
        if api_key is not None:
            api_key["last_used_at"] = now_iso
            api_key["updated_at"] = now_iso
            _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)
        _save("usage_rollups.json", rollups)
        _save("tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "NO_ROUTE", provider="amap")

    distance = int(500 + (abs(hash(oaddr + "->" + daddr)) % 20000))
    duration = int(distance / 3.5)  # seconds-ish
    response_body = {
        "route": {
            "type": "bicycling",
            "origin": {"address": oaddr, "city": ocity},
            "destination": {"address": daddr, "city": dcity},
            "paths": [
                {
                    "distance_m": distance,
                    "duration_s": duration,
                    "steps": [
                        {"instruction": f"从 {oaddr} 出发", "distance_m": max(50, distance // 10), "duration_s": max(30, duration // 10)},
                        {"instruction": "沿道路骑行至目的地附近", "distance_m": max(50, distance * 7 // 10), "duration_s": max(30, duration * 7 // 10)},
                        {"instruction": f"到达 {daddr}", "distance_m": max(10, distance // 10), "duration_s": max(10, duration // 10)},
                    ],
                }
            ],
        },
        "provider": {"name": "amap", "endpoint": "bicycling", "provider_key_id": pk.get("id")},
    }

    _log_tool_call(
        tool_calls, tenant_id, api_key_id, pk.get("id"), "succeeded",
        {"origin_address": origin_address, "destination_address": destination_address, "origin_city": origin_city, "destination_city": destination_city},
        normalized, cache_key, cache_ttl_seconds, 200, "amap/bicycling", response_body,
        None, None, 1
    )
    r_t_day["success_count"] += 1
    r_t_month["success_count"] += 1
    r_t_day["billed_units"] += 1
    r_t_month["billed_units"] += 1

        return _err("RATE_LIMIT", "Rate limit or quota exceeded.", reason=reason)

    cached = None
    for tc in reversed(tool_calls):
        if tc.get("cache_key") == cache_key and tc.get("tool_name") == tool_name and tc.get("tenant_id") == tenant_id and tc.get("status") == "succeeded":
            ttl = tc.get("cache_ttl_seconds")
            if isinstance(ttl, int) and ttl > 0:
                try:
                    created_dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(tc.get("created_at").replace("Z", ""))
                    if (now - created_dt).total_seconds() <= ttl:
                        cached = tc
                        break
                except Exception:
                    pass

    cache_ttl_seconds = 300
    if cached is not None:
        body = cached.get("response_body")
        _log_tool_call(tool_calls, tenant_id, api_key_id, None, "succeeded",
                       {"origin": origin, "destination": destination},
                       normalized, cache_key, cache_ttl_seconds, 200, None, body,
                       None, None, 1)
        r_t_day["success_count"] += 1
        r_t_month["success_count"] += 1
        r_t_day["billed_units"] += 1
        r_t_month["billed_units"] += 1
        if r_k_min is not None:
            r_k_min["success_count"] += 1
            r_k_min["billed_units"] += 1
        if api_key is not None:
            api_key["last_used_at"] = now_iso
            api_key["updated_at"] = now_iso
            _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)
        _save("usage_rollups.json", rollups)
        _save("tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return {"data": body, "meta": {"cached": True, "cache_key": cache_key}}

    pk = _select_provider_key(provider_keys, tenant_id)
    if pk is None:
        _log_tool_call(tool_calls, tenant_id, api_key_id, None, "failed",
                       {"origin": origin, "destination": destination},
                       normalized, cache_key, cache_ttl_seconds, 503, "amap/walking", None,
                       "UPSTREAM_ERROR", "No active provider key available for tenant.", 0)
        r_t_day["error_count"] += 1
        r_t_month["error_count"] += 1
        if r_k_min is not None:
            r_k_min["error_count"] += 1
        _save("usage_rollups.json", rollups)
        _save("tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No provider key available to dispatch request.")

    def _haversine_m(lng1, lat1, lng2, lat2):
        R = 6371000.0
        phi1, phi2 = math.radians(lat1), math.radians(lat2)
        dphi = math.radians(lat2 - lat1)
        dl = math.radians(lng2 - lng1)
        a = math.sin(dphi/2)**2 + math.cos(phi1)*math.cos(phi2)*math.sin(dl/2)**2
        return 2 * R * math.asin(math.sqrt(a))

    dist_m = int(_haversine_m(olng, olat, dlng, dlat))
    if dist_m <= 0:
        dist_m = 1
    # simulated walking limit
    if dist_m > 100000:
        _log_tool_call(tool_calls, tenant_id, api_key_id, pk.get("id"), "failed",
                       {"origin": origin, "destination": destination},
                       normalized, cache_key, cache_ttl_seconds, 404, "amap/walking", None,
                       "NO_ROUTE", "No walking route available for the given distance.", 1)
        r_t_day["error_count"] += 1
        r_t_month["error_count"] += 1
        r_t_day["billed_units"] += 1
        r_t_month["billed_units"] += 1
        if r_k_min is not None:
            r_k_min["error_count"] += 1
            r_k_min["billed_units"] += 1
        if api_key is not None:
            api_key["last_used_at"] = now_iso
            api_key["updated_at"] = now_iso
            _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)
        _save("usage_rollups.json", rollups)
        _save("tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "NO_ROUTE", provider="amap")

    duration_s = int(dist_m / 1.2)
    body = {
        "route": {
            "type": "walking",
            "origin": {"location": normalized["origin"]},
            "destination": {"location": normalized["destination"]},
            "paths": [{"distance_m": dist_m, "duration_s": duration_s, "steps": [{"instruction": "开始步行", "distance_m": dist_m, "duration_s": duration_s}]}],
        },
        "provider": {"name": "amap", "endpoint": "walking", "provider_key_id": pk.get("id")},
    }

    _log_tool_call(tool_calls, tenant_id, api_key_id, pk.get("id"), "succeeded",
                   {"origin": origin, "destination": destination},
                   normalized, cache_key, cache_ttl_seconds, 200, "amap/walking", body,
                   None, None, 1)
    r_t_day["success_count"] += 1
    r_t_month["success_count"] += 1
    r_t_day["billed_units"] += 1
    r_t_month["billed_units"] += 1
    if r_k_min is not None:
        r_k_min["success_count"] += 1
        r_k_min["billed_units"] += 1
    if api_key is not None:
        api_key["last_used_at"] = now_iso
        api_key["updated_at"] = now_iso
        _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)

    _save("usage_rollups.json", rollups)
    _save("tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
    return {"data": body, "meta": {"cached": False, "cache_key": cache_key}}

tool_schemas.implementation:
def maps_search_detail(poi_id, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, hashlib, secrets

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0086000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0086000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now_dt = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0)
    now_iso = now_dt.isoformat() + "Z"
    tool_name = "maps_search_detail"

    # ---- validate inputs ----
    if not isinstance(poi_id, str) or not poi_id.strip():
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "poi_id must be a non-empty string")

    poi_norm = poi_id.strip()
    normalized_params = {"poi_id": poi_norm}
    cache_key = hashlib.sha256(
        (tool_name + "|" + json.dumps(normalized_params, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)).encode("utf-8")
    ).hexdigest()

    tenants = _load("tenants.json")
    api_keys = _load("api_keys.json")
    provider_keys = _load("amap_provider_keys.json")
    tool_calls = _load("tool_calls.json")
    usage_rollups = _load("usage_rollups.json")

    def _new_id(prefix):
        return f"{prefix}_{secrets.token_hex(12)}"

    def _floor(dt, gran):
        if gran == "minute":
            return dt.replace(second=0, microsecond=0)
        if gran == "hour":
            return dt.replace(minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
        if gran == "day":
            return dt.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
        if gran == "month":
            return dt.replace(day=1, hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
        return dt.replace(second=0, microsecond=0)

    def _isoz(dt):
        return dt.replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _find_or_create_rollup(tenant_id, api_key_id, tool, gran, window_start_iso):
        for r in usage_rollups:
            if (
                r.get("tenant_id") == tenant_id
                and r.get("api_key_id") == api_key_id
                and r.get("tool_name") == tool
                and r.get("window_granularity") == gran
                and r.get("window_start") == window_start_iso
            ):
                return r
        r = {
            "id": _new_id("amap_usa"),
            "tenant_id": tenant_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key_id,
            "tool_name": tool,
            "window_start": window_start_iso,
            "window_granularity": gran,
            "requests_count": 0,
            "success_count": 0,
            "error_count": 0,
            "rate_limited_count": 0,
            "billed_units": 0,
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso,
        }
        usage_rollups.append(r)
        return r

    # ---- Resolve an ambient auth context that can serve this call ----
    # This tool has no credential parameter. Per contract, caller is authenticated; we must find a working
    # tenant + active provider key combination, not fail just because we chose a bad tenant.
    active_tenants = [t for t in tenants if t.get("status") == "active" and isinstance(t.get("id"), str)]
    if not active_tenants:
        # Record an attempted call with no resolvable tenant context
        call_row = {
            "id": _new_id("amap_call"),
            "tenant_id": "unknown",
            "api_key_id": None,
            "provider_key_id": None,
            "mcp_session_id": None,
            "tool_name": tool_name,
            "status": "failed",
            "request_params": {"poi_id": poi_id},
            "normalized_params": normalized_params,
            "cache_key": cache_key,
            "cache_ttl_seconds": 3600,
            "http_status": 401,
            "provider_endpoint": None,
            "provider_request_id": None,
            "response_body": None,
            "error_code": "UNAUTHORIZED",
            "error_message": "no active tenant context available",
            "duration_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "billed_units": 0,
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso,
        }
        tool_calls.append(call_row)
        _save("tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "no active tenant context available")

    # pick tenant that actually has an active provider key (needed on cache miss)
    def _tenant_has_active_provider(tid):
        for pk in provider_keys:
            if pk.get("tenant_id") == tid and pk.get("status") == "active":
                return True
        return False

    tenant = None
    for t in active_tenants:
        if _tenant_has_active_provider(t.get("id")):
            tenant = t
            break
    if tenant is None:
        # No tenant can serve provider calls; still allow cache hit if exists (cache stored in tool_calls)
        tenant = active_tenants[0]

    tenant_id = tenant.get("id")

    # ---- Create tool_call row (received) ----
    call_id = _new_id("amap_call")
    call_row = {
        "id": call_id,
        "tenant_id": tenant_id,
        "api_key_id": None,
        "provider_key_id": None,
        "mcp_session_id": None,
        "tool_name": tool_name,
        "status": "received",
        "request_params": {"poi_id": poi_id},
        "normalized_params": normalized_params,
        "cache_key": cache_key,
        "cache_ttl_seconds": 3600,
        "http_status": None,
        "provider_endpoint": None,
        "provider_request_id": None,
        "response_body": None,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "duration_ms": None,
        "billed_units": 1,
        "created_at": now_iso,
        "updated_at": now_iso,
    }
    tool_calls.append(call_row)

    # ---- Quota enforcement (tenant daily/monthly) ----
    # Use usage_rollups tenant-level totals (api_key_id None, tool_name None)
    day_start = _isoz(_floor(now_dt, "day"))
    month_start = _isoz(_floor(now_dt, "month"))
    day_roll = _find_or_create_rollup(tenant_id, None, None, "day", day_start)
    month_roll = _find_or_create_rollup(tenant_id, None, None, "month", month_start)

    # increment request counts first (observable dynamics); if rate limited, increment rate_limited_count accordingly
    day_roll["requests_count"] = int(day_roll.get("requests_count") or 0) + 1
    month_roll["requests_count"] = int(month_roll.get("requests_count") or 0) + 1
    day_roll["updated_at"] = now_iso
    month_roll["updated_at"] = now_iso

    daily_quota = tenant.get("daily_request_quota")
    monthly_quota = tenant.get("monthly_request_quota")
    if not isinstance(daily_quota, int) or daily_quota < 0:
        daily_quota = 0
    if not isinstance(monthly_quota, int) or monthly_quota < 0:
        monthly_quota = 0

    # tenant lifecycle check: suspended/deleted cannot create new tool_calls
    if tenant.get("status") in ("suspended", "deleted"):
        call_row["status"] = "failed"
        call_row["http_status"] = 403
        call_row["error_code"] = "TENANT_INACTIVE"
        call_row["error_message"] = f"tenant status={tenant.get('status')} forbids new tool calls"
        call_row["billed_units"] = 0
        call_row["updated_at"] = now_iso

        day_roll["rate_limited_count"] = int(day_roll.get("rate_limited_count") or 0) + 1
        month_roll["rate_limited_count"] = int(month_roll.get("rate_limited_count") or 0) + 1
        day_roll["updated_at"] = now_iso
        month_roll["updated_at"] = now_iso
        call_row["duration_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)

        _save("usage_rollups.json", usage_rollups)
        _save("tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "tenant is not allowed to issue new requests", tenant_id=tenant_id, status=tenant.get("status"))

    # quota reached => rate limited
    if daily_quota and int(day_roll.get("requests_count") or 0) > daily_quota:
        call_row["status"] = "rate_limited"
        call_row["http_status"] = 429
        call_row["error_code"] = "RATE_LIMITED"
        call_row["error_message"] = "tenant daily quota reached"
        call_row["billed_units"] = 0
        call_row["updated_at"] = now_iso

        day_roll["rate_limited_count"] = int(day_roll.get("rate_limited_count") or 0) + 1
        month_roll["rate_limited_count"] = int(month_roll.get("rate_limited_count") or 0) + 1
        day_roll["updated_at"] = now_iso
        month_roll["updated_at"] = now_iso
        call_row["duration_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)

        _save("usage_rollups.json", usage_rollups)
        _save("tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("RATE_LIMIT", "tenant daily quota reached", tenant_id=tenant_id)

    if monthly_quota and int(month_roll.get("requests_count") or 0) > monthly_quota:
        call_row["status"] = "rate_limited"
        call_row["http_status"] = 429
        call_row["error_code"] = "RATE_LIMITED"
        call_row["error_message"] = "tenant monthly quota reached"
        call_row["billed_units"] = 0
        call_row["updated_at"] = now_iso

        day_roll["rate_limited_count"] = int(day_roll.get("rate_limited_count") or 0) + 1
        month_roll["rate_limited_count"] = int(month_roll.get("rate_limited_count") or 0) + 1
        day_roll["updated_at"] = now_iso
        month_roll["updated_at"] = now_iso
        call_row["duration_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)

        _save("usage_rollups.json", usage_rollups)
        _save("tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("RATE_LIMIT", "tenant monthly quota reached", tenant_id=tenant_id)

    # ---- status transition: received -> validated ----
    call_row["status"] = "validated"
    call_row["updated_at"] = now_iso

    # ---- cache lookup (use existing succeeded results for same cache_key within TTL) ----
    cached = None
    ttl = call_row.get("cache_ttl_seconds")
    for r in reversed(tool_calls):
        if r.get("id") == call_id:
            continue
        if r.get("tool_name") != tool_name:
            continue
        if r.get("cache_key") != cache_key:
            continue
        if r.get("status") != "succeeded":
            continue
        if not r.get("response_body"):
            continue
        if ttl is None:
            cached = r
            break
        try:
            created_s = r.get("created_at")
            if isinstance(created_s, str) and created_s.endswith("Z"):
                created_dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(created_s[:-1])
            elif isinstance(created_s, str):
                created_dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(created_s)
            else:
                created_dt = None
        except Exception:
            created_dt = None
        if created_dt is None:
            cached = r
            break
        age = (now_dt - created_dt).total_seconds()
        if age <= int(ttl):
            cached = r
            break

    if cached is not None:
        # validated -> cache_hit -> succeeded
        call_row["status"] = "cache_hit"
        call_row["updated_at"] = now_iso
        call_row["provider_key_id"] = None
        call_row["provider_endpoint"] = None

        call_row["status"] = "succeeded"
        call_row["http_status"] = 200
        call_row["response_body"] = cached.get("response_body")
        call_row["error_code"] = None
        call_row["error_message"] = None
        call_row["duration_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        call_row["updated_at"] = now_iso

        # update rollups (tenant totals, tool-specific totals)
        tool_min_roll = _find_or_create_rollup(tenant_id, None, tool_name, "minute", _isoz(_floor(now_dt, "minute")))
        tool_day_roll = _find_or_create_rollup(tenant_id, None, tool_name, "day", day_start)
        tool_month_roll = _find_or_create_rollup(tenant_id, None, tool_name, "month", month_start)
        for rr in (tool_min_roll, tool_day_roll, tool_month_roll):
            rr["requests_count"] = int(rr.get("requests_count") or 0) + 1
            rr["success_count"] = int(rr.get("success_count") or 0) + 1
            rr["billed_units"] = int(rr.get("billed_units") or 0) + int(call_row.get("billed_units") or 0)
            rr["updated_at"] = now_iso

        # tenant-level billed units
        for rr in (day_roll, month_roll):
            rr["success_count"] = int(rr.get("success_count") or 0) + 1
            rr["billed_units"] = int(rr.get("billed_units") or 0) + int(call_row.get("billed_units") or 0)
            rr["updated_at"] = now_iso

        _save("usage_rollups.json", usage_rollups)
        _save("tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return {"poi": call_row["response_body"], "cache": {"hit": True, "cache_key": cache_key}, "tool_call_id": call_id}

    # ---- cache miss: choose provider key (must be active and same tenant) ----
    eligible = [pk for pk in provider_keys if pk.get("tenant_id") == tenant_id and pk.get("status") == "active"]
    if not eligible:
        call_row["status"] = "failed"
        call_row["http_status"] = 503
        call_row["error_code"] = "PROVIDER_KEY_UNAVAILABLE"
        call_row["error_message"] = "no active provider key available for tenant"
        call_row["billed_units"] = 0
        call_row["duration_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        call_row["updated_at"] = now_iso

        for rr in (day_roll, month_roll):
            rr["error_count"] = int(rr.get("error_count") or 0) + 1
            rr["updated_at"] = now_iso

        _save("usage_rollups.json", usage_rollups)
        _save("tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "no active provider key available for tenant", tenant_id=tenant_id)

    # weighted choice; if all weights 0 choose first
    total_w = 0
    weights = []
    for pk in eligible:
        w = pk.get("weight")
        if not isinstance(w, int) or w < 0:
            w = 0
        weights.append(w)
        total_w += w
    if total_w <= 0:
        chosen = eligible[0]
    else:
        r = secrets.randbelow(total_w)
        acc = 0
        chosen = eligible[0]
        for pk, w in zip(eligible, weights):
            acc += w
            if r < acc:
                chosen = pk
                break

    call_row["provider_key_id"] = chosen.get("id")
    call_row["provider_endpoint"] = "amap/poi/detail"
    call_row["status"] = "dispatched"
    call_row["updated_at"] = now_iso

    # ---- offline provider simulation: return a structured POI from poi_id ----
    # Real service would call upstream; offline we must still be consistent and not fabricate NOT_FOUND for arbitrary ids.
    # If we can find a previously succeeded response for this exact poi_id (regardless of cache_key differences), reuse it.
    reuse = None
    for r in reversed(tool_calls):
        if r.get("tool_name") != tool_name:
            continue
        np = r.get("normalized_params") or {}
        if np.get("poi_id") != poi_norm:
            continue
        if r.get("status") == "succeeded" and r.get("response_body"):
            reuse = r.get("response_body")
            break
    if reuse is None:
        # Create deterministic minimal POI detail payload
        reuse = {
            "id": poi_norm,
            "name": poi_norm,
            "location": None,
            "address": None,
            "source": "offline-simulated",
        }

    call_row["status"] = "succeeded"
    call_row["http_status"] = 200
    call_row["response_body"] = reuse
    call_row["error_code"] = None
    call_row["error_message"] = None
    call_row["duration_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    call_row["updated_at"] = now_iso

    # ---- rollups update ----
    tool_min_roll = _find_or_create_rollup(tenant_id, None, tool_name, "minute", _isoz(_floor(now_dt, "minute")))
    tool_day_roll = _find_or_create_rollup(tenant_id, None, tool_name, "day", day_start)
    tool_month_roll = _find_or_create_rollup(tenant_id, None, tool_name, "month", month_start)

    for rr in (tool_min_roll, tool_day_roll, tool_month_roll):
        rr["requests_count"] = int(rr.get("requests_count") or 0) + 1
        rr["success_count"] = int(rr.get("success_count") or 0) + 1
        rr["billed_units"] = int(rr.get("billed_units") or 0) + int(call_row.get("billed_units") or 0)
        rr["updated_at"] = now_iso

    for rr in (day_roll, month_roll):
        rr["success_count"] = int(rr.get("success_count") or 0) + 1
        rr["billed_units"] = int(rr.get("billed_units") or 0) + int(call_row.get("billed_units") or 0)
        rr["updated_at"] = now_iso

    _save("usage_rollups.json", usage_rollups)
    _save("tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
    return {"poi": call_row["response_body"], "cache": {"hit": False, "cache_key": cache_key}, "tool_call_id": call_id}

tool_schemas.name: mcp_whoami
tool_schemas.description: 返回当前调用方的鉴权身份与可用权限信息（tenant/api_key 归属、scopes/能力集）以及当前分钟/当日/当月的配额与限流消耗概览；用于在发起地图工具调用前确认“我是谁/我还能调用多少”。鉴权缺失或无效返回 UNAUTHORIZED；若 api_key 已 revoked 或 tenant 非 active 返回 FORBIDDEN，并附带拒绝原因。

mcp_session_id.description: MCP 会话 ID；用于关联审计与会话级上下文。

api_key.description: 调用方 API Key 明文；用于鉴权与归属判定（服务端仅存 hash，不回传）。

include_usage.description: 是否返回使用量与配额窗口统计摘要。

usage_window_granularities.description: 要返回的使用量窗口粒度列表；默认返回 minute/day/month。

tool_schemas.name: admin_tool_calls_list
tool_schemas.description: 按条件分页查询工具调用审计记录（tool_calls），支持按 tenant/api_key/tool_name/status/时间范围过滤；用于排查失败、追踪上游请求与缓存命中情况。鉴权缺失/无权返回 UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN；tenant 为 suspended/deleted 时仍允许读取历史记录，但会隐藏敏感字段（如 provider_key_id 的密钥内容本就不返回）。

mcp_session_id.description: MCP 会话 ID；用于审计与权限上下文。

api_key.description: 调用方 API Key 明文；必须属于目标 tenant 才能查询。

tenant_id.description: 租户 ID；不传则默认取 api_key 归属租户。

tool_name.description: 工具名精确匹配过滤（例如 maps_geo）。

tool_schemas.name: admin_tool_calls_get
tool_schemas.description: 按 ID 获取单条工具调用审计记录（tool_calls），返回规范化参数、缓存键、上游端点与请求耗时、计费单元等，用于精确追踪一次调用链路。鉴权缺失/无权返回 UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN；记录不存在返回 NOT_FOUND。

mcp_session_id.description: MCP 会话 ID；用于审计与权限上下文。

api_key.description: 调用方 API Key 明文；必须属于该记录 tenant 才允许读取。

tool_schemas.name: admin_usage_rollups_list
tool_schemas.description: 分页查询用量聚合（usage_rollups），用于查看某租户/某 key 在分钟/小时/日/月窗口内的请求量、成功/失败/限流次数与计费单元。鉴权缺失/无权返回 UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN；tenant 不存在返回 NOT_FOUND。

mcp_session_id.description: MCP 会话 ID；用于审计与权限上下文。

api_key.description: 调用方 API Key 明文；必须属于目标 tenant 才能查询。

tenant_id.description: 租户 ID；不传则默认取 api_key 归属租户。

api_key_id.description: 按具体 api_key_id 过滤；不传则汇总显示该 tenant 下所有 key 的 rollups（按后端实现返回）。

window_start_to.description: 窗口起始时间上界（不含），ISO8601。

tool_schemas.name: admin_amap_provider_keys_create
tool_schemas.description: 为指定租户创建一条高德开放平台 Key 配置（amap_provider_keys），用于后续转发调用的上游鉴权；服务端会加密存储 provider_key，不会在任何读取接口中回传明文。鉴权缺失/无权返回 UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN；tenant 非 active 返回 FORBIDDEN；参数不合法返回 VALIDATION_ERROR。

mcp_session_id.description: MCP 会话 ID；用于审计与权限上下文。

api_key.description: 调用方 API Key 明文；必须对目标 tenant 具备管理权限。

label.description: Key 的业务标签/备注（例如 prod-primary）。

provider_key.description: 高德开放平台 Key 明文；仅用于创建/更新写入，加密后存储。

weight.description: 权重，用于加权轮询/选 key；0 表示不参与分流或最低优先级（以服务端策略为准）。

status.description: 初始状态；disabled 表示不参与上游转发。

tool_schemas.name: admin_amap_provider_keys_update
tool_schemas.description: 更新指定租户的高德 Key 配置（amap_provider_keys），支持启用/停用与权重调整，或轮换 provider_key（明文仅写入不回传）。状态变更必须符合生命周期：active 可转 disabled，disabled 可转 active；非法越级更新将返回 CONFLICT 并记录告警。鉴权缺失/无权返回 UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN；记录不存在返回 NOT_FOUND；tenant 非 active 返回 FORBIDDEN。

mcp_session_id.description: MCP 会话 ID；用于审计与权限上下文。

api_key.description: 调用方 API Key 明文；必须对目标 tenant 具备管理权限。

provider_key.description: 新的高德开放平台 Key 明文；用于轮换密钥（加密后存储），不回传。

status.description: 更新状态（遵循生命周期转换约束）。

metadata.name: 高德地图 MCP Server
metadata.description: 该后端用于支撑“高德地图 MCP Server”的多种查询类工具：地理编码/逆地理编码、IP 定位、天气、POI 搜索/详情、距离测算与多种出行路径规划。系统核心工作流是：客户端携带某个 MCP 会话与鉴权上下文发起工具调用，服务对参数进行规范化与缓存命中判断，必要时向高德开放平台转发请求并持久化请求/响应与配额消耗，用于审计、限流、计费与问题追踪。 Repository: https://github.com/sseaan/amap-mcp-server Homepage: https://smithery.ai/server/@sseaan/amap-mcp-server
